title: On this day in Korea - October 29, 2022 : Itaewon crowd crush
caption:
On October 29, 2022, a devastating crush occurred in Seoul's Itaewon district. The loss of 159 lives triggered a national shift in safety regulations for all public events.

Source: Koreaherald - On this day in Korea - October 29, 2022 : Itaewon crowd crush
